h1: Accept crypto payments for trading education, signals, and mentorships
subheading: Dynopay lets forex and trading educators, signal groups, and mentors get paid in Bitcoin, stablecoins, and 15+ cryptocurrencies directly to a wallet they control — a high-risk vertical cards routinely reject.
intro_paragraph: Trading education, signals, and mentorship are flagged as high-risk by card processors, leading to declined applications, frozen funds, and disputes from members who lose money in their own trades. Dynopay is a non-custodial crypto payment gateway that settles straight to your wallet. Charge for a signals subscription, a mentorship, or a course with a payment link, hosted checkout, or the REST API across 15+ cryptocurrencies, with fees from 1.5% down to 0.5% at scale, no chargebacks, no monthly fees, and a free first payment.

features.title: Approval without the high-risk gatekeeping
features.description: You don't need a card processor to approve a 'trading education' merchant account. Add a payout wallet and start accepting crypto the same day.

features.title: No disputes from members' trading losses
features.description: Crypto payments are final, so a member who has a bad trading week can't reverse your fee through a card chargeback after receiving the signals.

features.title: Global audience, instant settlement
features.description: Traders are everywhere. Accept payment worldwide and receive funds in minutes to a wallet you control, in stablecoins if you want a dollar-pegged balance.

how_it_works: Sign up, verify your email, create a company profile, and add one payout wallet address for settlement.
Generate a payment link for each plan or embed the checkout on your community or landing page.
The member pays in their preferred cryptocurrency, you grant access via webhook, and funds arrive in your wallet within minutes.

faqs.question: Why do trading educators and signal providers use crypto payments?
faqs.answer: Trading education is classed as high-risk, so card processors often decline the account or freeze funds, and members sometimes dispute charges after a losing week. Crypto is non-custodial and final: no high-risk approval, no freeze, and no post-delivery chargebacks.

faqs.question: Can I run a recurring signals subscription with crypto?
faqs.answer: Yes, on a per-cycle basis. Crypto has no card-style auto-charge, so each renewal is a fresh payment — use the REST API and webhooks to send a payment link every billing cycle and grant or revoke access automatically.

faqs.question: Which cryptocurrencies can members pay with?
faqs.answer: Dynopay supports 15+ cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Solana, XRP, TRX, MATIC, and stablecoins such as USDT (ERC20, TRC20, Polygon), USDC (ERC20), and RLUSD.

faqs.question: What are the fees?
faqs.answer: Fees start at 1.5% plus one dollar per successful payment and drop to 0.5% as settled volume grows. No setup fees, no monthly fees, and your first payment is free.

faqs.question: Does Dynopay hold my money?
faqs.answer: No. Dynopay is non-custodial, so payments settle directly to your own wallet — MetaMask, Coinbase, Ledger, or any address you control.
